compartment_residuals.tracheal_air_side_rule: now = initial + inflow(from air bath) - outflow(to air bath) - transfer to tissue
compartment_residuals.tissue_rule: now = initial + transfer from trachea - consumption

oxygen_nmol.rule: amount_now = initial + inflow - outflow - consumption + residual; the residual is reported for every substance and is never corrected, clamped or hidden

compartment_residuals.haemolymph_rule: now = initial + inflow - outflow - consumption; no O2 term exists in this compartment

trehalose_nmol.rule: amount_now = initial + inflow - outflow - consumption + residual; the residual is reported for every substance and is never corrected, clamped or hidden

values.sleep_status: NO sleep state exists in this module. Any quiescent stretch is labelled REST by a movement criterion only.

layers.units: body-local mm for positions; layer index is dimensionless

registration.method: laid on the abdomen, plane 1:1, NOT registered
registration.notice: the plane geometry comes from mechanics.build_hex_mesh, the layer the project validated in 2-D; the cells are prisms, not free 3-D shapes, and the thickness deviation is multiplied by a declared gain for visibility

model.note: layer POSITIONS and spacing are 1:1; the deviation from the rest stack is multiplied by deviation_gain so the deformation is visible at body scale. That gain is declared here and shown in the UI.

notices: One frame, one clock, layered: independent simulations are labelled, not merged.
CNS placement is by named nerve-root landmarks, NOT anatomical registration.
Brain/VNC subdivision is a display split; no measured boundary exists.
Neural activity is an engineering response model on real connectivity, not measurement.
Electrodes: 7 um / 20 um fixed; capture radius declared; no spike sorting implemented.
